name: relay-gpu-market-intelligence
title: Relay GPU Market Intelligence
description: Collects real public GPU market data from Vast.ai, RunPod, and Akash Network. Normalizes offers, tracks price and capacity changes across runs, emits new/updated/disappeared events, and can push directly into Relay's Tiger Data-backed API. Akash capacity is unpriced bid-based inventory, not a fixed or executable price.
